comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Obtained randomly from mysterious objects in the Sea of Wonders -- this item can then be used in various recipes from the Production Techniques of the Great Lighthouse casting book (but only for those who have unlocked SoW as detailed under its page comments). Visit the recipe book's page for full details and links to the various items that can be made with this material. Cheers.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
To update, these are only obtained from the Sea of Wonders #1 - Alexandria; Candia's SoW2 does not drop them. In addition to the above, this item will also become important when the future update "Ice and Snow Leviathan" (or something to that effect) releases -- it will be used in the creation of the 叡智の大砲 / "Cannon of wisdom" item, a necessary component to creating 20-gate cannons. The recipe on JP wiki is:

Alchemy r11 / Casting r15
This item (base material)
Orichalcum x1
Improved Steel Sheet x10
Gaseous Drug x10
800 Sophia points

Two other cannon items can also be used: Broken Cannon (700 Sophia) and Weathered Cannon (500 Sophia). Cheers.
Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Skill/Product/Alchemy/Sophia
